# @trysac/autocomplete-index

> In-memory autocomplete index for TypeScript: trie prefix search with typo tolerance by Levenshtein distance, diacritic-insensitive matching and weighted, deterministic ranking. ESM library for Node.js 20+, no runtime dependencies, MIT.

- [README](README.md): problem, installation and usage example
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and boundaries
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Vitest tests and covered behavior
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope, timeline and effort metrics
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used
